title: Guards Who Cannot Be Neighbours
statement:
A tree has `n` nodes, and node `i` has a weight `w_i`. Choose a set of nodes so that no two chosen nodes are joined by an edge. Find the largest possible total weight of the chosen nodes.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `w_1 ... w_n`. Each of the next `n - 1` lines contains the two nodes joined by an edge.

## Output
Print the largest possible total weight.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 8000`
- `1 <= w_i <= 10^9`
- The edges form a tree.
